description: BLIND-SPOT CLOSURE R8 (reform components reach the situation model, 2026-07-12). `reform_overcomplex_clause` (seeds/reading_aperture.json) + its mechanical executor (`reading_drive._execute_pending_reforms`) already decompose an over-complex SentenceParse into component `part_of`/marker predications and record them as `reform_predications` -- but, deliberately deferred at that wave, those components never reached the SmEntity/SmEvent situation model itself (only the parse node's own JSON attr). THIS seed closes that gap the SAME two-stage way reform_pending/reform_done already works: a rule DECIDES a completed reform's components belong in the model (`ingest_reform_components`, marking `reform_ingest_pending` on the SentenceParse once `reform_done=1`), and the mechanical executor (`reading_drive._execute_pending_reform_ingests`, run both opportunistically inside `_shim_monitoring` and via this seed's ALWAYS-ON `reform_ingest_reflex` -- mirroring `reading_reform_reflex.json`'s own two-call-site rationale, since the SAME 'material-triggered dispatch can settle before the rule fires' race applies one level up) mints the real graph structure: a `part_of` predication mints a real `part_of` EDGE between two SmEntity nodes via the EXISTING `inference_generation._mint_part_of` mechanical idiom (part_of is not a change-of-state verb `situation_model_reader.ingest_predication` would otherwise mint), stamped `from_reform=1` on the part SmEntity for provenance; any other reform predication (a compound-tail marker) is handed to `coref_entities.resolve_and_ingest`, the SAME reused entity/event minting path the live reading spine already uses. Guarded by `reform_ingested` (the `kin_monitored`/`reform_done` idiom applied one level up) -- exactly-once, and the once-per-sentence `kin_monitored` KINSHIP guard is UNTOUCHED (it reads `resolved_predications`, never `reform_predications`, so re-ingesting the reform's components never re-triggers or duplicates a kinship scan).

microtheory.name: reading_reform_ingest
microtheory.description: a standing rule + reflex that mechanically re-ingests a completed reform's decomposed component predications into the flow's own situation model.

rules.name: ingest_reform_components
rules.comment: DECISION: a SentenceParse whose reform has already completed (`reform_done=1`) has its components RE-INGESTED into the situation model -- marks `reform_ingest_pending=1`, the SAME pending/done handoff `reform_overcomplex_clause` itself uses one stage earlier. Mint-once (both Not guards).
